name: Familial Isolated Hypoparathyroidism Due to Agenesis of Parathyroid Gland
aliases: Congenital Hypoparathyroidism due to Parathyroid Agenesis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Familial Isolated Hypoparathyroidism

criteria.description: Persistent hypocalcemia with low serum calcium levels
Inappropriately low or undetectable serum parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels
Absence or agenesis of parathyroid glands confirmed by imaging or surgical findings
Positive family history of isolated hypoparathyroidism without other syndromic features
Normal thyroid and adrenal function to exclude syndromic causes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of persistent hypocalcemia with low PTH levels and confirmed agenesis of parathyroid glands
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Exclusion of other causes of hypoparathyroidism such as autoimmune or syndromic forms is essential

laboratory: Low or undetectable serum parathyroid hormone (PTH)
imaging: Absence of parathyroid glands on neck ultrasound or sestamibi scan
Basal ganglia calcifications on brain CT or MRI
other: Normal thyroid and adrenal function tests to exclude syndromic hypoparathyroidism

distinguishingFeatures: Often associated with other autoimmune endocrinopathies
Hypoparathyroidism with thymic hypoplasia and cardiac defects

redFlags: Prolonged QT interval on ECG indicating risk of arrhythmia
Rapid onset of laryngospasm or airway compromise
references: Orphanet: Familial isolated hypoparathyroidism due to agenesis of parathyroid gland (ORPHA:2239)
Shoback D. Hypoparathyroidism. N Engl J Med. 2008;359(4):391-403.
Pearce SHS, et al. Familial isolated hypoparathyroidism: clinical and molecular aspects. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 1999;84(8):2736-2740.
